decisions: Treat $13T Treasury and $3T to $4T Prime as CEO-stated 2025 product volumes, with approximate 99.9 percent and 99 percent plus off-chain shares; do not call them XRP transaction volume.
Treat $160B as one percent scenario arithmetic and a 2027 on-chain-conversion measure discussed by the CEO, not a formal commitment, forecast or XRP-specific amount.
Preserve the CEO about-half RLUSD-on-XRPL claim and provider snapshots of about 29 to 39 percent as conflicting evidence until raw supply is reconciled.
Record Standard Chartered RLUSD custody on XRPL as live for eligible DIFC clients; it is not native XRP custody.
Record LMAX RLUSD collateral mirroring as planned, not live; it concerns RLUSD, not native XRP.
Record Ripple $150M financing to LMAX as corporate financing, not an XRP purchase or reserve allocation.
No new market feature is admitted and no directional forecast is issued.
required_verification: Read XRPL RLUSD issuer account and major-holder balances at pinned validated ledgers.
Read Ethereum RLUSD ERC20 totalSupply at the same UTC cutoff; reconcile treasury, frozen and escrow balances.
Verify LMAX/Standard Chartered collateral-mirroring production launch, eligible products, haircuts, balances and utilization.
Measure Ripple Treasury and Prime post-launch on-chain volumes by asset, chain, corridor and customer.
Separate XRP bridge demand from RLUSD settlement and tokenized-asset transfers.
